slides.title: Takata fix done? Check the VIN again.
slides.body: Toyota is recalling 314,029 vehicles for Takata front passenger airbag inflators.

slides.title: 2016–17 4Runner. 2017 GX 460.
slides.body: 35,949 4Runners and 8,931 GX 460s. Inflators fitted as earlier recall replacements are included too.

slides.title: Don't walk away. Get it fixed.
slides.body: The repair is free. Letters go out from Dec 28. Run the VIN, and ask a dealer too: NHTSA's lookup can lag.
slides.tag: No ruptures reported in this group

end.title: An old receipt isn't proof anymore.
end.body: My take, and what to check before you buy.
